ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #1
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship? (1 mark)
   A. Say Relationship has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Relationship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship.

2. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Destroy trees without planting

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

4. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Belief in with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Belief in to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Belief in has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic? (1 mark)

   D. Say Islamic has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in His? (1 mark)

   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in His.
   C. Apply the teaching of Belief in His with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Belief in His has no place in daily life.

   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Surah Naas.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Manners of? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Manners of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Manners of has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Manners of to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Manners of.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of? (1 mark)
   A. Use Pillars of to insult classmates of other faiths.

   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of.
   D. Say Pillars of has no place in daily life.

10. Which response best shows understanding of The Arabic? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Arabic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use The Arabic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say The Arabic has no place in daily life.

11. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

12. Which response best shows understanding of Names of Scriptures able to:? (1 mark)

   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Names of Scriptures able to:.
